entries.notes: Actual PSP UMD / ISO sample. Replace with a real local path or add a download_url + sha256 if you have a legally shareable sample. Add expect_frame_size, min_duration_seconds, expect_has_audio, expect_probe_has_audio, expect_audio_codec_contains, expect_probe_frame_size, expect_video_stream_count, expect_audio_stream_count, or expect_load_note_contains as needed for stricter corpus validation.

Optional raw .umd sample path for environments where the movie data is exposed as a .umd container instead of .iso. Use this to validate the extension-specific .umd probe/recovery path separately from .umd.iso images.

Optional extracted PSP PMF movie asset. Use this when you have a legally shareable standalone PMF file so odd-container probing and recovery can be validated on the raw console-era asset itself, not only on whole-disc images.

companions.notes: Optional companion cue sheet for BIN-based PlayStation samples. Keeping it alongside the BIN lets the packaged self-test and local odd-container retries exercise cue/bin track-layout recovery.

entries.notes: Actual PS1 BIN/CUE-style disc-image sample. Point the main path at the BIN and add the matching cue sheet as a companion so cue/bin retries can exercise real track-layout recovery. Use require_recovery plus expect_load_note_contains when you specifically want to prove the cue/bin recovery path stayed active, and add expect_probe_frame_size / expect_audio_codec_contains / expect_preferred_* stream assertions when you want a stricter stream-selection check.

Actual PS2 DVD ISO sample. Add preferred stream indexes or expected failure/load tokens per sample if needed. The validator now also supports expect_probe_has_audio, expect_probe_frame_size, expect_video_stream_count, expect_audio_stream_count, expect_video_stream_index, expect_audio_stream_index, expect_frame_size, require_recovery, and expect_preferred_* stream assertions.

Optional extracted PS2 PSS movie asset for validating the raw console program-stream file directly. Add expect_audio_codec_contains, require_recovery, or expect_load_note_contains when a real sample depends on alternate-track, audio-drop, or remux/transcode recovery.

companions.notes: Optional companion cue sheet for BIN-based PS2 samples so cue/bin retry logic can rebuild track layout during validation.

entries.notes: Optional PS2 BIN/CUE-style sample for validating .bin handling separately from DVD .iso files. Add expect_audio_codec_contains, require_recovery, and expect_load_note_contains when you want to confirm cue/bin or audio-drop recovery paths on a real sample.

Optional extracted PS1 STR movie asset for validating the raw console video file directly. Use expect_audio_codec_contains, require_recovery, and expect_load_note_contains when you want stricter assertions for alternate-track or audio-drop recovery on a real sample.
